Yeah. This is just annoying as hell.

When me and my partner had this happen to us i would always give a quick. "I know how to and i am fine with my current situation. I have no need for a sales representative. If you could put that in your system as not to have others also call which is a waste of your company time that would be great. "

And enough tried to still continue. " can i ask where you take X service from which company. " or whatever to try to keep the conversation going or get more informarion. Just give a stern "no. Anything else? " or "no, i am fine, no, i dont need to change."

After about 10 to 20 calls no one calls me again. Been quiet for a year with 2 or 3 attempts last year.
